in_marathi.name: Sharum
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharum हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharum is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shanti', meaning peace. It is a unisex name with a spiritual significance and is often used to convey a sense of calmness and tranquility.
